component_anchors.text: FY2017 identifies cookware as the product emphasis, and reported revenue and adjusted profit attributable to shareholders increased in each of FY2015-FY2017. The disclosed figures are consolidated, so the treatment is an incumbent enterprise reference rather than a product-level allocation. 因此，Eligible only for the incumbent earning-power route; no separate growth increment, product-line profit allocation or channel premium is supplied. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Maintain the treatment only if subsequent like-for-like disclosure continues to connect the cookware-weighted incumbent business to earnings without a conflicting component boundary. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利进入基准范围；普通股现金不适用；不改变融资压力；永久损失进入基准永久损失路径；估值作为主要估值输入。晋级检验：Disclose a consistent product- and channel-level bridge showing that the incumbent earnings reference is supported by durable margin and collection economics. 失效检验：Like-for-like disclosure shows that the cookware-weighted incumbent business loses earnings power or that the consolidated reference is dominated by a non-incumbent component.

Aggregate FY2017 operating cash flow declined from FY2016 while payments for long-lived assets increased; receivables, inventory and borrowings also increased. The package does not separate maintenance capital from growth capital or allocate these facts among components. 因此，Owner cash remains a conditional range and financing pressure is active; all long-lived-asset spending is treated as current capital-allocation and financing pressure, not as an asserted maintenance-capital amount. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Reconcile operating cash, maintenance spending, growth spending, working capital, debt and restricted assets on a common responsible-business boundary. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利不适用；普通股现金只进入条件范围；增加融资压力；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值只作为条件性主要估值输入。晋级检验：A common-boundary reconciliation separates operating cash, economic maintenance capital, growth capital, working-capital absorption, debt and restricted assets. 失效检验：The reconciliation shows that cash conversion and funding needs are materially weaker than implied by the reported aggregate deterioration, or that financing pressure is greater and cannot be sustained.

The source identifies robot, new-energy and logistics investments, but supplies no component-level revenue, customer acceptance, cost, operating cash, working capital, financing or return on the disclosed capital. 因此，Do not credit incremental normal earnings, owner cash or capital return from these activities; retain an unresolved route so their possible financing and permanent-loss effects remain visible. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Obtain a matched project or component bridge from customer acceptance through revenue, cost, working capital, cumulative cash and return on all committed capital. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利不适用；普通股现金尚未形成可承保范围；尚未形成可承保范围；永久损失尚未形成可承保范围；估值尚未形成可承保范围。晋级检验：For each material activity, provide responsibility-matched evidence of customer acceptance, revenue, cost, working capital, cumulative cash and return on capital. 失效检验：Component disclosure establishes continuing cash absorption or inadequate return on the committed capital, or establishes that the activity is immaterial.

economic_section_anchors.heading: 正常盈利组件桥
economic_section_anchors.text: 口径：Adjusted profit attributable to ordinary shareholders；Consolidated reported incumbent operations; no product, channel or project allocation is asserted.；截至 2017-12-31；单位 RMB。

economic_section_anchors.heading: 正常盈利组件桥
economic_section_anchors.text: The full FY2015-FY2017 reported adjusted-profit range is the bounded incumbent reference; it excludes reported non-recurring items but is not allocated to individual product lines or new projects.；带符号范围 7.99837e+07–1.42556e+08 RMB；组件权限：进入基准范围。

economic_section_anchors.anchor_id: 关键敏感性与翻转条件:1
economic_section_anchors.heading: 关键敏感性与翻转条件
economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：Consolidated revenue（FY2015-FY2017 reported history，单位 RMB）；低 2.24202e+09（FY2015 reported consolidated revenue），基准 2.54754e+09（FY2016 reported consolidated revenue），高 3.07155e+09（FY2017 reported consolidated revenue）。正常盈利传导（权限：进入基准范围）：影响未知：No disclosed margin, product mix, price, unit cost or component allocation converts a revenue case into a normal-earnings delta.；保守处理：Retain the historical adjusted-profit reference without attributing a revenue-driven increment.。普通股现金传导（权限：不适用）：影响未知：No responsibility-matched cash-conversion bridge is disclosed.；保守处理：Do not infer an owner-cash delta from reported revenue growth.。价值路线权限：进入基准价值路线；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：后续同口径披露显示炊具或消费耐用品的收入、利润或现金转化没有随已披露销售增长改善，或者产品和渠道组合与当前判断不同。

economic_section_anchors.anchor_id: 关键敏感性与翻转条件:2
economic_section_anchors.heading: 关键敏感性与翻转条件
economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：Operating cash flow（FY2015-FY2017 reported history，单位 RMB）；低 1.07125e+08（FY2017 reported operating cash flow），基准 1.30113e+08（FY2015 reported operating cash flow），高 3.14547e+08（FY2016 reported operating cash flow）。正常盈利传导（权限：不适用）：A reported operating-cash case does not mechanically restate the historical adjusted-profit reference.；影响范围 0–0 RMB。普通股现金传导（权限：只进入条件范围）：影响未知：The aggregate cash-flow statement does not make the required maintenance-versus-growth and component allocation separation.；保守处理：Keep owner cash conditional and do not subtract all long-lived-asset spending as maintenance capital.。价值路线权限：只进入条件性价值路线；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：后续披露能在同一责任边界内对经营现金、维持性支出、增长性长期资产投入、应收和存货以及借款进行对账，并显著改变当前的现金与融资压力判断。

economic_section_anchors.anchor_id: 关键敏感性与翻转条件:3
economic_section_anchors.heading: 关键敏感性与翻转条件
economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：FY2017 disclosed named robot, new-energy and logistics equity-investment amount（FY2017 disclosed investment items，单位 RMB）；范围 125100000–125100000（Sum of the disclosed 50 million, 10 million, 50 million, 10 million and 5.1 million RMB named equity-investment items.）。正常盈利传导（权限：不适用）：影响未知：No responsibility-matched incremental earnings evidence is disclosed.；保守处理：Do not credit new-project normal earnings.。普通股现金传导（权限：尚未形成可承保范围）：影响未知：The return and cash absorption of the named investments are not reported on a common responsibility boundary.；保守处理：Retain the expansion route as unresolved and do not credit owner cash.。价值路线权限：价值路线影响未决；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：后续按机器人、新能源或物流项目披露客户接受、收入、成本、营运资本、累计现金和投入回报，证明该项目可或不可从未决路线晋升。

reader_requirements.requirement: The existing report writer must retain every supplied reader-safe anchor once. It may add company-specific explanation but may not promote conditional, excluded, scenario-only, or unresolved component treatment.
